statement: The half-One vacuum carrier and generator-three unit carrier have the unique exact positive separation one-sixth. Transferring that beat to a held work carrier leaves one-third in the local vacuum carrier, and one-third plus one-sixth reconstructs the original half-One exactly. Thus a positive outward vacuum-to-work transfer is structurally admitted without creating support.
title: Positive asymmetric vacuum-beat extraction
